Sample: 5A 
Score: 9 

The response earned all 9 points. 

Sample: 5B 
Score: 6 

The response earned 6 points: 1 point in part (a), 1 point in part (b), no points in part (c), and 4 points in part (d). In 
part (a) the student uses f ′ to determine the slope but makes an arithmetic error, so the student did not earn the first 
point. The student uses the slope to present a line that passes through the given point, so the second point was 
earned. In part (b) the student attempts to use the Second Derivative Test. The student shows that 
( )
2

=
 so the 

first point was earned. The student makes an error in the computation of 
( )

 so the second point was not earned. 
In part (c) the student considers

 In part (d) the student’s work is correct. 

Sample: 5C 
Score: 3 

The response earned 3 points: 2 points in part (a), 1 point in part (b), no points in part (c), and no points in part (d). 
In part (a) the student’s work is correct. In part (b) the student earned the first point. Because the student’s 
justification does not refer to the sign of the first derivative of f, the student did not earn the second point. In part (c) 
the student does not report a value for k. In part (d) the student does not find a partial fraction decomposition, and 
the antiderivative is incorrect.
